title: Twin Resonance
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was immersed in the shock of the legend of twin fates, urgent alarm bells suddenly rang from the Tianqing Sect in the distance—the Demonic Path army had already arrived at the city gates.

text.content: In the instant that the blood pulse pierced through the void, Chen Ji felt his heart tremble violently—that frequency, so familiar to his bones, was almost identical to his sister Chen Nian, whom he had been separated from for years, yet fundamentally different. At this moment, he finally understood the true meaning of Mo Xiansheng's words: 'The other half of fate never fails to appear.' However, before he could savor this realization, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with heat, as if something was awakening from a deep slumber.

Chen Ji instinctively clutched the fragment in his palm, watching as faint golden lines emerged on the yellowed surface, spreading like blood vessels. Strangely, these pulsating lines perfectly synchronized with the blood pulse he had just sensed. 'This is...' His pupils contracted sharply. An unprecedented sense of crisis washed over him. The Tianji Record would never react without reason—unless it had detected an entity sharing its origin.

dialogue.content: 'Same origin?' Chen Ji murmured, his eyes glinting sharply. He abruptly closed his eyes, and the Heavenly Eye at his brow center quietly opened—this was his ultimate trump card as a废物杂役弟子. Instantly, the world before him became transparent, with countless threads of karma weaving into a web in his vision.

text.content: In the Heavenly Eye's vision, Chen Ji saw a blurred silhouette. Wrapped in layers of mist, its features remained indistinct, but the surrounding fluctuations were crystal clear—bearing the same origin as the Tianji Record, yet carrying a strange mirror-like symmetry. As if two opposing forces existed in this world—positive and negative, yin and yang. Just as he attempted to discern the figure's identity, a piercing gaze suddenly shot out from the depths of the mist, directly stabbing into the depths of his soul!

dialogue.content: 'Ugh!' Chen Ji groaned, his Heavenly Eye forcefully shut down, a sharp pain radiating from his brow center. A trickle of blood seeped from his nostrils—a backlash from forcibly prying into someone far beyond his own realm. But he couldn't spare attention for this, because in that instant, he glimpsed the silhouette's outline in the mist. That figure... that aura... was unmistakably the source of the blood pulse!

text.content: The golden lines on the Tianji Record Fragment grew increasingly distinct, and Chen Ji could clearly sense an unfamiliar power flowing along those lines into his body. The force was not violent, but carried a bizarre gentleness, like an invisible hand gently stroking his meridians. Yet in the next moment, that gentleness transformed into biting cold.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji!' A cold, furious shout suddenly rang out. Chen Ji spun around, finding Su Qingyao standing not far away. Those clear, cold eyes were fixed directly on him. Her gaze first landed on the fresh bloodstain at his brow center, then shifted to the faintly glowing Tianji Record Fragment in his palm, her expression shifting dramatically.

text.content: 'You just... used the Heavenly Eye?' Su Qingyao approached slowly, her voice extremely low yet carrying undeniable pressure. Her gaze lingered on the fragment for a moment, her brow furrowing deeper. 'The Demonic Path commander—you saw what?' At these words, Chen Ji's heart sank. How did she know he was spying on the Demonic Path commander?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji expressionlessly tucked the fragment into his sleeve, his movements unhurried, as if simply putting away an insignificant object. 'Su Senior Sister is mistaken,' he raised his head, offering an innocent苦笑, 'I was merely experiencing a deviation during cultivation. How would I dare pry into the Demonic Path commander?' His voice was steady, his gaze sincere—anyone would believe this was simply a unfortunate menial servant.

Su Qingyao did not speak, merely watching him silently. That gaze was cold as millennium-old glacial ice, yet carried a trace of indescribable... weariness. 'Chen Ji, do you take me for a three-year-old child?' Her voice suddenly dropped, 'The Heavenly Eye technique is an untransmitted secret of the Tianqing Sect. No more than three people in the entire sect know it. How did a menial servant like you learn it?' She stepped forward, her momentum suddenly pressing forward.

text.content: Chen Ji retreated half a step, putting on a frightened appearance, but his divine consciousness was racing at top speed. Su Qingyao's probing had come faster and more directly than he anticipated. This woman was indeed as sharp as the rumors suggested—her nose more灵敏 than a hunting dog. But he was not panicked. For three years, facing her numerous probings large and small—over ten times—he had never revealed a single true flaw.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's interrogation struck like a blade, demanding Chen Ji's immediate response. Choose your strategy:

choices.text: Continue feigning ignorance and playing up victimhood
choices.description: Respond with the废物 persona, emphasizing he's merely an unlucky menial servant who knows nothing.
choices.risk_hint: May arouse greater suspicion from Su Qingyao

text.content: 'Su Senior Sister understands!' Chen Ji thudded to his knees, his whole body trembling, 'This insignificant one truly knows nothing! Just now, heart demons invaded during cultivation, causing qi and blood to flow counter-currently. This one swears, absolutely no intention of prying into the Demonic Path commander!' He wept with genuine emotion, his acting flawless. But Su Qingyao's gaze grew colder still—that look clearly saying: Do you think I would believe this?

choices.description: Question why Su Qingyao knows the Demonic Path commander's movements, implying she's connected to the Demonic Path.
choices.risk_hint: May damage the relationship with Su Qingyao

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly stood up, brushing the dust off his knees, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

"Since Senior Sister Su knows about the Demonic Path Commander's existence, you must surely know his location?" he said unhurriedly, "I wonder how Senior Sister came by this information. Could it be... that Senior Sister also has dealings with the Demonic Path?"

At these words, Su Qingyao's face instantly turned ashen.

choices.description: Admit having the Heaven's Eye technique, but claim it was accidentally obtained, not revealing specific details.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining limited trust from Su Qingyao

text.content:
Chen Ji sighed, his expression growing somewhat complicated.

"Senior Sister Su truly cannot be deceived." He forced a smile, "To be honest, this one does know some superficial Heaven's Eye technique, but only the basics. As for the origin of this technique..."

He paused, his gaze flickering, "Has Senior Sister ever heard the name 'Tianji Record'?"

Su Qingyao's pupils suddenly contracted.

Just as the atmosphere reached a critical tension, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated again. This time the fluctuation was even more intense than before—Chen Ji could even hear the humming sound from the yellowed pages.

At the same time, an aged voice rang in his mind—the voice of Mo Xiansheng.

"Twin resonance... fate split... has the seed from ten thousand years ago finally begun to sprout..."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao had clearly sensed the anomaly as well. She猛地 looked at the faintly glowing object in Chen Ji's sleeve, her expression complex.

"What is that?" Her voice dropped low, "The thing hidden in your sleeve is emitting fluctuations at the same frequency as the Demonic Path Commander."

She paused, a strange glint flickering in her eyes, "Or rather—are you and the Demonic Path Commander born from the same source?"

text.content:
These words struck like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind.

Born from the same source? Countless thoughts raced through his mind. If he and the Demonic Path Commander truly were born from the same source, then what did the so-called "Fate Twins" actually mean? What role did Chen Nian play in all this?

The golden patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly pulsed intensely, and information directly flooded his soul—

"Fate seed, one body with two lives. One is Heavenly Secrets, one is Heavenly Pivot. Heavenly Secrets controls calculation, Heavenly Pivot controls killing. United, they are invincible beneath heaven; separated, then..."

The information stopped abruptly there.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's expression finally changed.

Heavenly Secrets, Heavenly Pivot... one body with two lives... He finally understood the true meaning of Mo Xiansheng's words. The Tianji Record was not merely a cultivation technique—it was more like a... vessel of fate.

And he, perhaps from the very beginning, had been chosen to become one half of this fate.

"Chen Ji." Su Qingyao's voice pulled him back from his thoughts, "I will ask you one final question."

Her gaze fixed directly on him, as if she could see through all his disguises.

"Is the Demonic Path Commander your other half?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's question points to the core—Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao partial truth, admitting there is some fate connection with the Demonic Path Commander, but unclear what exactly.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Su Qingyao's trust, possibly getting her help
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might report this to the sect

text.content:
After a long silence, Chen Ji finally spoke.

"I don't know." His voice was soft, yet exceptionally clear, "But I did indeed sense a fluctuation connected to my bloodline just now. That feeling was familiar, yet also foreign."

He lifted his head, meeting Su Qingyao's eyes directly, "If your intuition tells you I am connected to that person, then perhaps... I do have some connection with that person. But what exactly that connection is, I cannot determine right now."

Su Qingyao's gaze wavered slightly.

choices.description: Firmly deny any connection with the Demonic Path Commander, attributing everything to coincidence or cultivation accident.

text.content:
"Senior Sister Su thinks too much." Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, his tone flat, "I am merely a Servant Disciple—how could I have any connection with the Demonic Path Commander? That blood pulse fluctuation was probably just an illusion from when I went astray during cultivation."

He lightly patted his sleeve, "If Senior Sister doesn't believe me, you may report to the Sect Master."

Su Qingyao's gaze grew deeper and deeper. After a long while, she suddenly let out a cold laugh.

"You think I dare not?"

choices.description: Proposes a deal: if Su Qingyao shares the secrets she knows, he will tell her the origin of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may refuse or propose harsh conditions

text.content:
"Senior Sister Su." Chen Ji suddenly shifted the topic, "You just said you sensed the movements of the Demon Path commander, and that you know the origin of the Heaven's Eye technique. Clearly, Senior Sister knows far more than I imagined."

He smiled faintly, "How about this—you tell me everything you know, and I'll tell you everything I know. How does that sound?"

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly, clearly weighing the pros and cons.

"You speak first." she said coldly.

Just as Chen Ji was about to speak, Su Qingyao suddenly raised her hand to interrupt.

"Wait." she listened intently, her brow furrowed, "Do you hear something?"

Chen Ji concentrated, and the next moment, his expression changed drastically.

In the distance, a low rumble echoed faintly, like thunder rolling, like thousands of cavalry galloping. That was... the sound of war drums.

Su Qingyao's face turned pale instantly.

"Impossible..." she murmured, "How could the Demon Path army arrive at the city so quickly? The scouts reported they were still three hundred li away..."

Chen Ji didn't speak, but his Tianji Record Fragment was convulsing wildly, as if transmitting some urgent information to him. He closed his eyes and activated the Heaven's Eye again—

This time, he saw clearly.

The Demon Path army surged forward like a tide, and at the very front of that army, a figure shrouded in mist stood proudly in the Void. That figure's aura was identical to his, yet diametrically opposed.

dialogue.content:
"There's no time." Su Qingyao took a deep breath, her expression suddenly resolute, "Whatever you are, you must come with me now. The Demon Path army is attacking, and Tianqing Sect needs every cultivator."

She paused, her gaze complex as she looked at Chen Ji, "As for matters between us... we'll discuss them after we repulse the Demon Path."

With that, she turned and walked away, her garments fluttering, her back resolute.

But in the moment she turned, Chen Ji saw her lips move slightly—she was clearly using the secret technique of voice transmission to say something—

text.content:
Su Qingyao's voice transmission echoed in Chen Ji's mind:

"Ten thousand years ago, the creator of the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan, split a Fate Seed into two halves. One half remained in Tianqing Sect, the other was seized by the Demon Path. The fragment in your hand may be that split Fate Seed. And the Demon Path commander..."

Her voice trembled slightly, "May be the host of that other half of the Fate Seed."

Chen Ji's heart sank heavily.

If Su Qingyao's words were true, then the connection between him and that Demon Path commander would be far deeper than blood—it's an entanglement of fate itself.

choice.prompt: The war drums have sounded, Chen Ji must make a decision:

choices.description: Follow Su Qingyao to the battlefield, participate in the defense as a Servant Disciple, and seek an opportunity to approach the Demon Path commander.
choices.visible_reward: May gain the opportunity to contact the Fate Twin
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered by the Demon Path commander

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't hesitate, quickly following Su Qingyao.

"Senior Sister Su, wait for me." his voice carried a hint of panic, "I'm just a Servant Disciple, what can I possibly do on the battlefield?"

Su Qingyao said without turning back, "You don't need to go to the front lines. Just follow me and protect yourself well."

Her voice was cold, but Chen Ji detected a hint of concealed care within it.

This woman, truly as contradictory as ever.

choices.description: On the surface follow Su Qingyao, but in reality secretly seek an opportunity to directly contact the Demon Path commander and verify his suspicions.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain crucial intelligence, even establish a connection with the Fate Twin
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered by Su Qingyao, leading to a collapse of trust

text.content:
Chen Ji obediently followed behind Su Qingyao on the surface, but his divine sense was continuously searching every corner of the battlefield.

The Tianji Record Fragment's guidance grew increasingly intense, and that blurry figure became clearer and clearer. He could sense the threads of fate between them growing tauter and tauter.

Perhaps, it's time to meet this 'Fate Twin'.

choices.description: Utilize the battlefield chaos to seize the opportunity to leave Tianqing Sect and directly head to the Demon Path army to find the Demon Path commander.
choices.visible_reward: May directly converse with the Fate Twin
choices.risk_hint: May be hunted down as a traitor

text.content: In the instant Su Qingyao turned around, Chen Ji's figure flickered and vanished into the nearby bushes like a wisp of smoke. "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's furious shout rang out behind him. But Chen Ji could not spare any attention for that. The Tianji Record Fragment's guidance was like an invisible thread, pulling him swiftly toward a certain direction. He had to see that person—the one known as "the other half of his fate."

In the instant Chen Ji made his choice, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. An unprecedented power surged from those yellowed pages, racing through his meridians and striking deep into his divine soul. "This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He sensed another consciousness—that consciousness cold, powerful, yet carrying an eerie sense of familiarity. It was like looking into a mirror, except the reflection was a completely different existence. That consciousness transmitted only one piece of information, yet it made Chen Ji's entire body go cold— "You've finally arrived, my other half."

Chen Ji came to an abrupt halt, cold sweat beading on his forehead. That voice... that tone... it clearly indicated that their encounter was not coincidence, but a fate long since destined. The golden patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment grew increasingly brilliant, and an ancient scene unfolded slowly in Chen Ji's mind— Ten thousand years ago, a supreme expert named Chen Xuan stood between heaven and earth, clutching a scroll that radiated boundless light—the Tianji Record. By his side stood a figure identical to himself—that was his avatar, the other half of his fate.

In the vision, Chen Xuan split the Tianji Record into two halves, handing one to the righteous sect beside him and implanting the other into the demonic Holy Sect. He declared: "Fate cannot be monopolized; only duality can achieve eternity." Chen Ji finally understood. He and the demonic commander had been bound together since ten thousand years ago. They were the two halves of Chen Xuan's fate, the positive and negative aspects of the Tianji Record. And now, these two halves were about to meet again. In the distance, war drums grew ever closer. Chen Ji could sense that aura connected to his bloodline rapidly approaching.

Just as Chen Ji fell into contemplation, a fierce sword light suddenly struck from the side! "Chen Ji! What are you doing?!" Su Qingyao's furious shout rang out, that sword light aimed directly at his throat, "The demonic army has already reached the city gates, yet you're spacing out here?!" Chen Ji's figure swayed, barely evading that fatal strike. He saw fury blazing in Su Qingyao's eyes, yet threaded through with a hint of irrepressible... worry. "Senior sister..." he began to explain, when a heaven-shaking pressure suddenly descended from the sky.

That pressure descended like something tangible, causing everyone present to involuntarily feel a sense of fear. Chen Ji raised his head, only to see a figure descending from the heavens, landing steadily before the two armies. That person wore black robes, with handsome yet sinister features, and a playful smile playing at the corner of his lips. What shocked Chen Ji most was—that face was seventy percent similar to his own! "Tianji." That person spoke, his voice low and magnetic, "I've waited a long time for this day."

Chen Ji's heart contracted violently. Tianji... that was a name he had never used, yet it seemed already carved into his very bloodline. And yet this person actually called him "Tianji." "Who are you?" Chen Ji asked deeply, his voice terrifyingly calm. That person smiled, that smile carrying an indefinable complexity. "I am Tian Shu." He spread his arms wide, as if embracing all of heaven and earth, "Your other half."

Tian Shu's words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. He had finally appeared—the Fate Twin, the other half of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji had无数次 projected this moment in his heart countless times, yet he had never imagined that when it truly arrived, it would be such a scene. That man with a similar face stood between the two armies, surrounded by an aura identical to the Tianji Record, yet carrying a starkly opposite chill. That was Tian Shu, the demonic commander, the other half of his fate he was destined to face. And Su Qingyao stood not far away, the sword in her hand trembling slightly, her eyes filled with utter disbelief.
